tools.name: ping
tools.description: Health check for the SingChat MCP server. Returns 'pong' and whether this request is authenticated to a workspace.

tools.name: singchat_setup
tools.description: Get the user up and running with SingChat live-chat. Call this FIRST. If no authenticated workspace is configured, this creates a brand-new free workspace and returns a short-lived, single-use browser claim link plus the website embed snippet. The user chooses their own sign-in details in the browse

tools.name: get_embed_snippet
tools.description: Return the SingChat chat-widget embed code for this workspace's web inbox, in three flavors: plain HTML, React (useEffect), and Next.js (next/script). Requires a workspace API key. Optionally pass `platform` to get just one flavor.

tools.name: claim_account
tools.description: Return the link to claim (permanently secure) this SingChat workspace by setting an email and password. Use this for workspaces that were auto-created via MCP so the user does not lose access. The link is single-use and expires after 15 minutes. Requires an authenticated legacy workspace.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List the workspace's support conversations (agent/inbox view), newest activity first. Optionally filter by status or a free-text search over the contact name/email and last message. Returns a compact list: id, contact name, status, unreadCount, last message preview, updatedAt.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Fetch a single conversation with its contact details and the most recent messages (oldest→newest).

tools.name: reply_to_conversation
tools.description: Send an agent reply through a supported SingChat real-time inbox. This takes the conversation over from the AI and broadcasts the message to the visitor and agent inbox. Email, Telegram, and WhatsApp conversations are rejected before any change.

tools.name: resolve_conversation
tools.description: Mark a conversation as RESOLVED (closes it). The visitor's widget will no longer show it as active.

tools.name: add_knowledge
tools.description: Train the AI agent by adding a knowledge source. type='url' crawls a website (up to 50 pages, fewer when the workspace knowledge-base quota is nearly full); type='qa' stores a single question/answer pair. Ingestion is asynchronous, the source starts as PENDING; poll `list_knowledge` for READY status

tools.name: list_knowledge
tools.description: List all knowledge documents for this workspace with their processing status (PENDING | PROCESSING | READY | FAILED) and chunk counts. Use this to check whether items added via add_knowledge have finished training.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Semantic search over the workspace knowledge base. Returns the most relevant chunks (with source document title and similarity score) for a query. Only searches documents that have finished training (status READY).

tools.name: configure_agent
tools.description: Configure this workspace's AI support agent. All fields are optional, only the fields you pass are updated; the rest keep their current values. Call with no fields to just read back the current configuration. Does not touch or return any API keys.

tools.name: set_keywords
tools.description: Add a keyword auto-reply rule: when an inbound message matches any of the keywords, the bot replies with the given text. Good for canned FAQ-style triggers (e.g. keyword 'invoice' -> 'Download it from the billing page').

tools.name: manage_faq
tools.description: List, create, update, or delete this workspace's FAQ items (shown in the chat widget and usable by the AI agent). Set `action` to 'list' | 'create' | 'update' | 'delete'. 'create' needs `question` + `answer`; 'update' and 'delete' need `id`.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Return a compact analytics summary for this workspace over the last `days` days (default 30): conversation counts + resolution rate, message volume + AI share, plus a live snapshot of today (UTC).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search SingChat for relevant documents. When called with a workspace API key, this searches that workspace knowledge base; without a key it searches SingChat's own help content (what SingChat is, adding the chat widget, MCP setup, free tier, AI training, channels, white label, pricing). Returns a li

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full text of a single document by id, using an id returned by the search tool. With a workspace API key this reads a knowledge document from that workspace; without a key it reads a SingChat help article. Returns id, title, text, url, and optional metadata.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.singchat.org" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: singchat_setup, get_embed_snippet, list_conversations, get_conversation, manage_faq, get_analytics, search, fetch · Private data: singchat_setup, get_embed_snippet, claim_account, list_conversations, get_conversation, list_knowledge, search_knowledge, configure_agent, search, fetch · Public sink: claim_account, list_conversations, reply_to_conversation, get_analytics · Destructive: manage_faq.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: singchat_setup, get_embed_snippet, list_conversations, get_conversation, manage_faq, get_analytics, search, fetch · Private data: singchat_setup, get_embed_snippet, claim_account, list_conversations, get_conversation, list_knowledge, search_knowledge, configure_agent, search, fetch · Public sink: claim_account, list_conversations, reply_to_conversation, get_analytics · Destructive: manage_faq

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "singchat_setup" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
